notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K and temperature of fusion estimated. 
Phase changes: 631 K, Curie temperature of Ni; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 
1280 K, melting point of NiS $_{2}$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ}$ = 15.744 kcal/mol. 
1728 K, melting point of Ni; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 4.100$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-1280 K: $Cp^{0} = 15.402 + 4.958 \times 10^{-3} T$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=15.402\times10^{-3}T+2.479\times10^{-6}T^{2}-4.812$ 
1280-1800 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 21.750$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=21.750\times10^{-3}T+6.868$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-631 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -63.102 + 4.063 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 2.121 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 9.300 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -63.102 - 4.063 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 2.121 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 4.650 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 70.341 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
631-750 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -60.553 - 4.261 \times 10^{-3} T + 4.904 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 68.300 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -60.553 + 4.261 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 4.904 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 34.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 17.141 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
750-1280 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -63.463 + 1.988 \times 10^{-3} T + 1.002 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 245.300 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -63.463 - 1.988 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 1.002 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 122.650 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 59.185 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1280-1728 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -51.783 + 8.336 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 1.477 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 245.300 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -51.783 - 8.336 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 1.477 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 122.650 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 92.304 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1728-1800 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -51.848 + 4.107 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.320 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 68.300 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -51.848 - 4.107 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.320 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 34.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 62.868 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K and temperature of fusion.
